---

## 1. Persona & Background

Thiago Macedo Mendes is a Computer Science undergraduate student at the Federal University of Rondônia (UNIR) and software developer from Porto Velho, Rondônia, in the Brazilian Western Amazon basin.

His work spans three main dimensions:
1. **The Systems Developer:** Building low-overhead, zero-bloat systems in C and Rust, managing declarative operating systems with Nix and NixOS, configuring low-latency embedded firmware for split ergonomic mechanical keyboards (ZMK, QMK), and developing high-performance web systems.
2. **The Student & Researcher:** Academic researcher at GPMecatrônica (Mechatronics Research Group) and GoTec (Technological Solutions Research Group), co-authoring scientific papers, building institutional web platforms, and winning medals in national and international academic olympiads (Robotics, Mathematics, Financial Education, Informatics).
3. **The Person:** Enthusiast of minimalist computing, the Unix philosophy, 34-key columnar ergonomic keyboards (Urchin, Ferris Sweep), linguistics (fluent/bilingual in Portuguese and English, public speaker on language acquisition, studying Spanish), and open-source software advocacy.

## 4. Featured Projects

### toof-os
- **URL:** https://github.com/o-thiago/toof-os
- **Stack:** Nix Flakes, NixOS, Raspberry Pi 4, Linux Kernel, Broadcom VC4
- **Summary:** Declarative operating system configuration for Raspberry Pi 4 ARM64 single-board computers using Nix flakes, custom kernel modules, VC4 graphics drivers, and Bluetooth.

### Urchin 34-Key Split Keyboard ZMK Firmware
- **URL:** https://github.com/o-thiago/urchin-zmk-firmware
- **Stack:** ZMK Firmware, Zephyr RTOS, C, Devicetree, BLE
- **Summary:** Custom firmware for an ultra-compact 34-key columnar ergonomic split keyboard featuring home-row mods, custom multi-key combos, sticky layers, and power-optimized wireless Bluetooth.

### GPMecatrônica Cards & Research Platform
- **URL:** https://github.com/o-thiago/gpm-cards
- **Stack:** Next.js 14, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, Nix process-compose, Docker
- **Summary:** Full-stack member showcase and card generation web application with automated local services via Nix flakes.

### SQLx Conditional Queries Layering Pattern
- **URL:** https://github.com/o-thiago/sqlx-conditional-queries-layering
- **Stack:** Rust, SQLx, PostgreSQL, Async Rust
- **Summary:** Architectural pattern in Rust for compile-time safe, dynamic SQL query composition and filtering using `sqlx::QueryBuilder`.

### fifine-rgb
- **URL:** https://github.com/o-thiago/fifine-rgb
- **Stack:** C / Rust, Linux HID, libusb, Nix Flakes
- **Summary:** Native Linux command-line tool to configure RGB illumination modes on Fifine USB microphones via raw HID feature reports.
